name: robots/rodriguesrenato__warehouse_robot_simulation
title: Warehouse robot simulation (ROS 1 / Gazebo)
intro: Warehouse robot simulation (ROS 1 / Gazebo), adapted from rodriguesrenato/warehouse_robot_simulation. It runs `submit_order`. `submit_order`: publish one std_msgs/String order on /warehouse/order/add. The receipt reports the string handed to rosbridge and is transmission evidence only: the upstream callback has no acknowledgement, and this action does not report queueing, robot motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
